data.narrative:
Revel is a Series B-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $180M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of nine private companies and one public reference (277810.KQ), with direct peer comparisons to same-stage robotics firms including Generalist AI, Bedrock Robotics, and Dexterity.

Two valuation methods are applicable. The stage-progression method applies a 1.9x multiplier to the $180M total raised as a baseline proxy, implying a valuation of $342M. The peer-median approach references three same-sector, same-stage comparables with a median valuation of $1.8B and a range spanning $1.6B to $2.0B. This reflects the broader Robotics & Manufacturing comp set, which includes Divergent and Exotec among the five leading private peers.

Triangulating these two methods yields a range of $291M (low) to $2.0B (high), with a median of $1.0B. The wide spread reflects material tension between the capital-efficiency signal from stage progression and the valuation density observed in the peer set. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the three-company peer sample and the applicability of step-up multiples to frontier manufacturing companies, where growth and margin trajectories may diverge from venture-backed software norms.
